success.description: 1. The critical wound is cancelled. Place recharge tokens on this card equal to that critical wound’s severity value

boon.description: That character is healed of 1 normal wound

bane.description: You suffer stress equal to the critical wound’s severity value

conservative.requirements: Favour equal to the critical wound’s severity (see below) special; When a character within Medium range is knocked unconscious, exceeding his wound threshold and receives a critical wound, you may immediately place a number of recharge tokens on this card equal to that critical wound’s value. Then you may attempt to stay hand. Make a Piety (WP) check as noted above and spend favour equal to the critical wound’s severity value
conservative.name: Stay Morrs Hand
